item.title: Label-free Nb 4 C 3 , Mo 2 Ti 2 C 3 , and Ta 4 C 3 MXenes reprogram monocyte and macrophage activation toward an anti-inflammatory state
item.description:
Authors: Giorgia Longo, Linda Giro, Recep Uyar, Benjamin Chacon, Christopher E. Shuck, Laura Fusco, Adil Ijaz, Natalya Resto-Trujillo, Mohammad Oliaeimotlagh, Amir Khan, Martina Zoccheddu, Valentina Palmieri, Acelya Yilmazer, Martina Pigazzi, Yury Gogotsi, Lucia Gemma Delogu, Klaus Ley, Marco Orecchioni

Nb 4 C 3 , Mo 2 Ti 2 C 3 , and Ta 4 C 3 MXenes promote low-inflammatory macrophage differentiation, reducing pro-inflammatory genes, cytokines, activation, and in vivo recruitment. Their elemental signatures enable label-free single-cell tracking.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00130k

item.title: Sharpening the cut: physical origins of rejection-curve broadening and routes to precision ultrafiltration
item.description:
Authors: Jamila G. Eatman, Chaoqiuyu Wang, Paul F. Nealey, Seth B. Darling

Ultrafiltration (UF) and loose nanofiltration (LNF) are effective strategies for a low-cost, scalable solute separation. Achieving highly selective separations in these regimes requires tackling several sources of broadening in the rejection curve.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00362a
